rationale: retained-ui-kernel: SvgPathWidget gains optional set_stroke_cap / set_stroke_join / set_stroke_miter_limit. Unset, it strokes exactly as before; set, the style is passed to Canvas::stroke_path so it stays local to the draw and never leaks into later views. Additive public setters with no change to existing behaviour or to any API or authority boundary; Pulp-only because it serves Pulp's design-import SVG lowering.
